  \gdef\analysisfigsetup{%
    % 图形参数
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figEllipseA}{2}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figEllipseB}{sqrt(3)}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figFocusX}{-1}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figSlope}{3/4}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figLineLeftX}{-2.25}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figLineRightX}{1.55}%
    % 由直线 y=\figSlope(x-\figFocusX) 与椭圆交点计算 P,Q
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figQuadA}{1/(\figEllipseA*\figEllipseA)+\figSlope*\figSlope/(\figEllipseB*\figEllipseB)}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figQuadB}{-2*\figSlope*\figSlope*\figFocusX/(\figEllipseB*\figEllipseB)}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figQuadC}{\figSlope*\figSlope*\figFocusX*\figFocusX/(\figEllipseB*\figEllipseB)-1}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figDelta}{\figQuadB*\figQuadB-4*\figQuadA*\figQuadC}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figPx}{(-\figQuadB+sqrt(\figDelta))/(2*\figQuadA)}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figQx}{(-\figQuadB-sqrt(\figDelta))/(2*\figQuadA)}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figPy}{\figSlope*(\figPx-\figFocusX)}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figQy}{\figSlope*(\figQx-\figFocusX)}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figRx}{-\figPx}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figRy}{-\figPy}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figLineLeftY}{\figSlope*(\figLineLeftX-\figFocusX)}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figLineRightY}{\figSlope*(\figLineRightX-\figFocusX)}%
    \coordinate (O) at (0,0);
    \coordinate (F) at (\figFocusX,0);
    \coordinate (P) at (\figPx,\figPy);
    \coordinate (Q) at (\figQx,\figQy);
    \coordinate (R) at (\figRx,\figRy);
  }
  \gdef\analysisfigsetupnative{%
    % 第一幅图使用 TikZ 原生路径求交：路径方向决定 Q、P 的稳定次序
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figEllipseA}{2}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figEllipseB}{sqrt(3)}%
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\figFocusX}{-1}%
    \coordinate (O) at (0,0);
    \coordinate (F) at (\figFocusX,0);
    % 该辅助点只确定静态图中直线 l 的初始方向，不作为可见对象
    \coordinate (analysisfigPguide) at (1,1.5);
    \coordinate (analysisfigLineStart) at ($(F)!-0.625!(analysisfigPguide)$);
    \coordinate (analysisfigLineEnd) at ($(F)!1.275!(analysisfigPguide)$);
    \path[name path=analysisfigC]
      (O) ellipse [x radius=\figEllipseA,y radius=\figEllipseB];
    \path[name path=analysisfigL]
      (analysisfigLineStart) -- (analysisfigLineEnd);
    \path[name intersections={
      of=analysisfigC and analysisfigL,
      sort by=analysisfigL,
      by={Q,P}
    }];
    \coordinate (R) at ($(O)!-1!(P)$);
  }
  \gdef\analysisfigbase{%
    \draw[-{Stealth[length=1.7mm,width=1.3mm]}] (-2.45,0) -- (2.5,0) node[below] {$x$};
    \draw[-{Stealth[length=1.7mm,width=1.3mm]}] (0,-2.1) -- (0,2.15) node[left] {$y$};
    \draw (0,0) ellipse [x radius=\figEllipseA,y radius=\figEllipseB];
    \draw (\figLineLeftX,\figLineLeftY) -- (\figLineRightX,\figLineRightY) node[right] {$l$};
  }
  \gdef\analysisfigbasenative{%
    \draw[-{Stealth[length=1.7mm,width=1.3mm]}] (-2.45,0) -- (2.5,0) node[below] {$x$};
    \draw[-{Stealth[length=1.7mm,width=1.3mm]}] (0,-2.1) -- (0,2.15) node[left] {$y$};
    \draw (0,0) ellipse [x radius=\figEllipseA,y radius=\figEllipseB];
    \draw ($(F)!-0.625!(analysisfigPguide)$) -- ($(F)!1.275!(analysisfigPguide)$) node[right] {$l$};
  }
  \gdef\analysisfigpoints{%
    \foreach \X in {O,F,P,Q,R}{\fill (\X) circle (1pt);}
    \node[below right=-1pt] at (O) {$O$};
    \node[above=8pt,left=-5pt] at (F) {$F$};
    \node[above=9pt,right=-8pt] at (P) {$P$};
    \node[above=3pt,left=1pt] at (Q) {$Q$};
    \node[below=8pt,left=-5pt] at (R) {$R$};
  }
      \begin{tikzpicture}[line width=0.9pt,scale=0.9,line cap=round,line join=round]
        \analysisfigsetupnative
        \begin{scope}[draw=none]
          \fill[lectureteal!14] (P) -- (Q) -- (R) -- cycle;
          \fill[lecturegold!30,opacity=0.72] (P) -- (F) -- (O) -- cycle;
        \end{scope}
        \analysisfigbasenative
        \draw (P) -- (Q) -- (R) -- cycle;
        \draw (P) -- (F) -- (O) -- cycle;
        \draw[dashed] (Q) -- (O);
        \analysisfigpoints
      \end{tikzpicture}

      \begin{tikzpicture}[line width=0.9pt,scale=1.25,line cap=round,line join=round]
        \analysisfigsetup
        \pgfmathsetmacro{\angleFigTikzScale}{1.25}
        \pgfmathsetmacro{\angleFigScale}{1}
        \pgfmathsetmacro{\angleFigPx}{(\figPx-\figQx)*\angleFigScale}
        \pgfmathsetmacro{\angleFigPy}{(\figPy-\figQy)*\angleFigScale}
        \pgfmathsetmacro{\angleFigRx}{(\figRx-\figQx)*\angleFigScale}
        \pgfmathsetmacro{\angleFigRy}{(\figRy-\figQy)*\angleFigScale}
        \pgfmathsetmacro{\angleFigFPos}{(\figFocusX-\figQx)/(\figPx-\figQx)}
        \pgfmathsetlengthmacro{\angleFigQFRadius}{\angleFigTikzScale*\angleFigFPos*sqrt(\angleFigPx*\angleFigPx+\angleFigPy*\angleFigPy)*1cm}
        \coordinate (Q) at (0,0);
        \coordinate (P) at (\angleFigPx,\angleFigPy);
        \coordinate (R) at (\angleFigRx,\angleFigRy);
        \coordinate (F) at ($(Q)!\angleFigFPos!(P)$);
        \coordinate (Qxdir) at ($(Q)+({0.52*\angleFigPx},0)$);
          \coordinate (Qxleft) at ($(Q)+({-0.20*\angleFigPx},0)$);
          \coordinate (Qxright) at ($(Q)+({1.14*\angleFigPx},0)$);
          \coordinate (Rincl) at ($(Q)!-0.86!(R)$);
          \coordinate (Rray) at ($(Q)!1.4!(R)$);
          \draw[lectureline] (Qxleft) -- (Qxright);
          \draw (Q) -- ($(Q)!2!(F)$);
          \draw (Rincl) -- (Rray);
          \node[font=\small,anchor=west] at ($(Q)!2!(F)$) {$QP:k_{QP}=\tan\alpha$};
          \node[font=\small,anchor=west] at (Rray) {$QR:\ k_{QR}=\tan\beta$};
          \pic[draw=lectureblue!70!black,line width=0.65pt,angle radius=10pt,angle eccentricity=1.7,"$\alpha$"] {angle=Qxdir--Q--P};
          \pic[draw=lecturegold!80!black,line width=0.65pt,angle radius=26pt,angle eccentricity=1.35,"$\beta$"] {angle=Qxdir--Q--Rincl};
          \pic[draw=lecturered!85!black,line width=0.8pt,angle radius=\angleFigQFRadius,angle eccentricity=1.2,"$\theta$"] {angle=R--Q--P};
          \foreach \X in {F,Q,R}{\fill (\X) circle (1pt);}
          \node[above=9pt,left=-8pt] at (F) {$F$};
          \node[below=9pt,left=-3pt] at (Q) {$Q$};
          \node[below=7pt,left=-3pt] at (R) {$R$};

      \end{tikzpicture}

          \node[above=9pt] at (1.14,0.37) {$k=\frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}=\frac baK$};
